answer: Sybil floods fail if voting seats are issued per unique collateral source rather than per key. A newcomer files a funding fingerprint into a public oasis registry; that fingerprint may nourish only one franchise, which carries zero weight until it crosses a 72-hour confirmation horizon of uninterrupted, non-cloned settlement. Once mature, the franchise occupies a haven of at most one voting seat for that fingerprint. A second key presenting the same source is refused, and the original seat freezes for slash review, so alias swarms cannot multiply influence.
